routines.name: BSP_Game_ReceiveContactWorldPoints
routines.contract: ECX receiver, stack records/count, RET8. Receiver is actual game+1Ch; vector at receiver+4. Reserve uninitialized 12-byte by-value fill, resize using unsigned count, then signed count loop over 58h records. Checked bounds handler may return. Copy record first world point through three x87 FLD/FSTP operations. Complete one-slot CE78C0 source table owner borrows matching allocator. Newly defined 130-byte function; prior function ends 4D4CDD.

routines.contract: ECX vector, stack count and by-value three words, RET10h. Signed truncating byte-distance/12 sizes compared with unsigned requested count. Grow at current end through full 41FA40 insert, shrink through full 4C82B0 erase; preserve returning invalid-parameter checks and no-op equality.

routines.name: STL_CheckedVector12_InsertFill_0041FA40
routines.contract: ECX vector, stack iterator owner/position/count/value pointer, RET10h. Snapshot three source words with MOVSS before all branches. Empty range skips move.
